# agentgateway_traffic_gateway (Resource)

Manages a traffic gateway: the listener that routes HTTP, HTTPS, TCP and TLS traffic through agentgateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Placeholder PEM material so this example validates without certificate
# files. Replace the values with real certificates (or file() references to
# them) before applying the configuration.
locals {
  server_cert = "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nplaceholder-server-certificate\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
  server_key  = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nplaceholder-server-key\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
  secure_cert = "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nplaceholder-secure-certificate\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
  secure_key  = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nplaceholder-secure-key\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
}

# A gateway with a server-side TLS certificate. Routes attach to it by name.
resource "agentgateway_traffic_gateway" "public" {
  name         = "public"
  port         = 8443
  bind_address = "0.0.0.0"
  protocol     = "HTTPS"

  tls_json = jsonencode({
    cert = local.server_cert
    key  = local.server_key
  })
}

# A gateway with named listeners. When listeners is set, only port and
# bind_address may be configured at the top level; TLS and policies move to
# the individual listeners.
resource "agentgateway_traffic_gateway" "multi_listener" {
  name         = "multi-listener"
  port         = 8080
  bind_address = "0.0.0.0"

  listeners {
    name     = "http"
    hostname = "example.com"
    protocol = "HTTP"
  }

  listeners {
    name     = "https"
    hostname = "secure.example.com"
    protocol = "HTTPS"

    tls_json = jsonencode({
      cert = local.secure_cert
      key  = local.secure_key
    })
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The gateway name referenced by routes.

### Optional

- `api_key_json` (String, Sensitive) API key authentication policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `authorization_json` (String, Sensitive) Authorization rules for incoming HTTP requests. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `basic_auth_json` (String, Sensitive) Basic Auth policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `bind_address` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address to listen on. Omit it to listen on all interfaces.
- `cors_json` (String, Sensitive) CORS policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `ext_authz_json` (String, Sensitive) External authorization service policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `ext_proc_json` (String, Sensitive) External processing service policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `jwt_auth_json` (String, Sensitive) JWT bearer token authentication policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `listeners` (Block List) Named listeners. When set, only port and bind_address may be configured at the top level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--listeners))
- `oidc_json` (String, Sensitive) OIDC authorization code flow policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `port` (Number) The port to listen on. Omit it to use the server default.
- `protocol` (String) The gateway protocol: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP or TLS. Omit it to default to HTTP, or HTTPS when tls_json is set.
- `tls_json` (String, Sensitive) Server TLS configuration. Mutually exclusive with listeners.
- `transformations_json` (String, Sensitive) Request and response transformation policy. Mutually exclusive with listeners.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The gateway name, which is also the server-side id.
- `revision` (Number) The server revision of the stored gateway.

<a id="nestedblock--listeners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listeners`

Optional:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname served by this listener. Wildcards are allowed; unset serves all domains.
- `name` (String) The listener name used by gateway references like gateway/listener.
- `protocol` (String) The listener protocol: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP or TLS.
- `tls_json` (String, Sensitive) TLS configuration for this listener.
